$about: capability -> the code globs that must move with its spec (R11).

Keys starting with $ are metadata, not capabilities. $unclaimed declares the paths that belong to no capability, so `spec-guard --audit` can report code nobody claims instead of staying silent about it - prose, config and this repo's own zone-1 tooling are not capabilities.

The guards under standard/scripts/ are listed one by one rather than as one glob, on purpose: they are shipped code with no capability spec yet, and a blanket entry would hide that. The shipped skills outside the spec-* and cycle-* families are in the same position, inside the standard/.claude/** entry.
